roam.albumGuide.beforeSave.en: Save this card first, then view the instructions. An identical card already saved here will not be saved again.
roam.albumGuide.beforeSave.zh-Hans: 先保存这张卡，再查看发布指引；本页已成功保存过的同一张卡不会重复保存。

roam.albumGuide.momentsAction.en: Save card and view Moments guide
roam.albumGuide.momentsAction.zh-Hans: 存图并查看朋友圈指引

roam.albumGuide.xiaohongshuAction.en: Save card and view Xiaohongshu guide
roam.albumGuide.xiaohongshuAction.zh-Hans: 存图并查看小红书指引

roam.albumGuide.saved.en: This card was saved to Photos

roam.albumGuide.momentsSteps.en: Open WeChat Moments yourself and select the saved card from Photos. You can use the suggested text below.
roam.albumGuide.momentsSteps.zh-Hans: 请自行打开微信朋友圈，从相册选择刚保存的足迹卡。可参考下面的文案。

roam.albumGuide.xiaohongshuSteps.en: Open Xiaohongshu yourself and select the saved card from Photos. You can use the suggested text below.
roam.albumGuide.xiaohongshuSteps.zh-Hans: 请自行打开小红书，从相册选择刚保存的足迹卡。可参考下面的文案。

roam.albumGuide.notPosted.en: Nothing has been posted. Choose who can see it in the other app before publishing.
roam.albumGuide.notPosted.zh-Hans: 尚未发布任何内容。发布前，请在对应应用中自行设置谁可以看到。

roam.albumGuide.copyHint.en: Touch and hold to select text. Unknown statistics are omitted. Nothing is copied to the clipboard automatically.
roam.albumGuide.copyHint.zh-Hans: 可长按选择文案。未记录的统计不会补成零，也不会自动写入剪贴板。
